title: Phase 53 promotes six bounded records after primary-source review
summary: FTFN promoted six official or primary-source records covering critical-minerals funding, AI-for-science research, gallium supply structure, large-load service conditions, one named electric-service project, and Toronto's development-delivery baseline. The public set now contains nine Published signals; 23 records remain In Review and one remains a Draft Sample.
evidence_note: Every promoted record passed the current publication gate. Funding remains distinct from awards or results; national commodity data remains distinct from facility disruption; tariff eligibility remains distinct from customer capacity; one project remains distinct from corridor readiness; and Toronto pipeline potential remains distinct from completed housing.
